items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I met John Reinhardt and Stephen Corpelli

ctx.x: You know? But I did like Paris; I met John Reinhardt and Stephen Corpelli, and Alex Combelle and oh, Phil Brun and Arthur Briggs -- people like that.

items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you also were jamming with people like Django Reinhardt.

ctx.x: When you got to Paris, aside from playing in this sort of society, more staid kind of thing, you also were jamming with people like Django Reinhardt.
